imports.modification_summary: Runs over Orcel's content model (rendered, visible text only) and returns a pruned tree. An empty query, or one with no word after stop words, filters nothing; the donor's page-derived query (title, meta tags, first long paragraph) is not ported, so a page cannot choose its own relevance. No stemming (the donor's use_stemming=False path). Words lose edge punctuation; a chunk's text pieces are joined with a space. A kept chunk keeps its own text plus the childless elements of its element, so text is never repeated. Query bounded to 1024 bytes and 32 words.
imports.authority_delta: None: still untrusted page text, produced inside the worker from the same snapshot.

imports.modification_summary: The dynamic threshold with the donor's weights and tag importance; min_word_threshold and preserve lists not ported. tag_len is the length of the content model serialised as HTML. The class/id term is kept but, as in the donor, never adds score. Iterative, not recursive.
Noise set, stop words and the length rule as upstream.

imports.source: rank_bm25 BM25Okapi (called by the donor; k1 1.5, b 0.75, epsilon 0.25)
imports.modification_summary: The published Okapi formula with rank_bm25's negative-idf floor, reimplemented; no rank_bm25 code is copied. An all-empty corpus scores zero instead of NaN.

not_imported.reason: REJECT in DONOR_REGISTRY: a model call per page, outside the extraction budget.
The TypeScript port covers the same behaviour; no Python is shipped.

residuals: Extraction relevance is an ExtractOptions field; the worker frame and host/MCP extract surface do not carry it yet (same pattern as WI-01/WI-02 core-first).
Orcel has no About surface yet; when one exists it must show the attribution sentence (the license names an About or Credits section for applications).
